description: DeFi highest APY & yield radar powered by DeFiLlama. Finds top lending and liquidity pools for any token (USDC, ETH, USDT, WBTC) filtered by blockchain and minimum TVL.

limit.description: Number of top pools to return (1-20, default: 5)

min_tvl_usd.description: Minimum pool TVL in USD for safety filtering (default: 100000)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2/v1 Base64 or JSON EIP-3009 USDC payment signature to unlock the full unmasked dataset directly via MCP

symbol.description: Token symbol to earn yield on (default: 'USDC')

x_api_key.description: Optional ak_live_... 30-day Prepaid API Pass key to unlock the full unmasked dataset

name: defi_yields
